source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 26 exercise hal (PDF 157-159): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short, constructed aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, muwazna tables, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 26 (Polymers) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab diye gaye hain. Polymer structures condensed formulas mein likhe gaye hain, misal [–CH₂–CHCl–]ₙ. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Which pair of monomers reacts to form a polyester?
(Kaun sa monomers ka jora polyester banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polyester mein ester links –COO– hote hain; diol ka –OH dicarboxylic acid ke –COOH se react karta hai aur paani nikalta hai (26.1.2). Diamine aur dicarboxylic acid se polyamide banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
II. What small molecule is eliminated when a diamine reacts with a dioyl chloride?
(Diamine aur dioyl chloride ke reaction mein kaun sa chhota molecule nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diamine ka –NH₂ dioyl chloride ke –COCl se react karta hai; N ka H aur C ka Cl mil kar HCl ban kar nikalte hain (26.1.2):
n H₂N–R–NH₂ + n ClOC–R'–COCl → [–HN–R–NH–CO–R'–CO–]ₙ + 2n HCl

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (b) mein formula 'Hcl' chhapa hai; hydrogen chloride ka sahi formula HCl hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. How do plasticizers affect PVC?
(Plasticizers PVC par kya asar karte hain?)

options.text: Reduce inter-chain forces, make it flexible

blocks.explanation: Plasticizers polymer chains ke darmiyan mazboot forces ko kam karte hain, chains aasaani se hilti hain aur PVC naram aur lachakdaar (flexible) ho jata hai (26.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
IV. What are the two monomers for Nylon 6,6?
(Nylon 6,6 ke do monomers kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon 6,6 hexamethylenediamine H₂N–(CH₂)₆–NH₂ aur adipic acid HOOC–(CH₂)₄–COOH se banta hai; dono mein chhe (6) carbon atoms hain (26.1.2, 26.2).

blocks.prompt:
V. A polymer section is shown: [-CH₂-CH(CH₃)-CH₂-CH(CH₃)-]... What is the monomer, and what type of polymer is it?
(Polymer ka hissa diya gaya hai. Monomer kya hai aur polymer kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Backbone mein sirf C–C bonds hain, is liye yeh addition polymer hai. Repeat unit –CH₂–CH(CH₃)– hai; is ke C–C ko wapas C=C banane se CH₂=CH–CH₃, yani propene milta hai (26.3).

blocks.prompt:
VI. Polyesters and polyamides are considered biodegradable because they:
(Polyesters aur polyamides biodegradable kyun maane jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mitti ke jandaar ester aur amide links ko hydrolysis (paani se torna) ke zariye tor dete hain, aur polymer carboxylic acids aur alcohols ya amines mein toot jata hai (26.5.1).

blocks.prompt:
VII. What are the products of alkaline hydrolysis (saponification) of a polyester?
(Polyester ki alkaline hydrolysis (saponification) ke products kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Ester link ki hydrolysis se acid aur alcohol bante hain (26.5.1); alkali (misal NaOH) mein acid foran neutralize ho kar apna salt ban jata hai:
–CO–O– + NaOH → –COO⁻Na⁺ + HO– (carboxylate salt + alcohol; alkali wala hissa chapter se aage hai)

blocks.prompt:
VIII. What are the products of acidic hydrolysis of a polyamide?
(Polyamide ki acidic hydrolysis ke products kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Amide link ki hydrolysis se carboxylic acid aur amine bante hain (26.5.1); acid mein amine (jo base hai) H⁺ le kar protonated amine ban jati hai (chapter se aage):
–CO–NH– + H₂O + H⁺ → –COOH + ⁺H₃N–

blocks.prompt:
IX. What is the primary cause of photodegradation in polymers?
(Polymers ki photodegradation ki asal wajah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: C=O jaise groups suraj ki UV roshni jazb karte hain; is se chain ke bonds kamzor ho jate hain aur polymer toot jata hai (26.5.2).

blocks.prompt:
X. Poly(alkenes) are considered "chemically inert" because they:
(Poly(alkenes) ko 'chemically inert' kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: have strong C-C and C-H bonds.

blocks.explanation: Poly(alkenes) mein sirf mazboot, non-polar C–C aur C–H bonds hain aur koi reactive functional group nahi, is liye acids, alkalis aur jaraseem in par asar nahi karte (26.5).

blocks.prompt:
a) Kevlar® is a thermally and mechanically very stable but flexible polymer; a section of this polymer is given below:
[–C(=O)–C₆H₄–C(=O)–NH–C₆H₄–NH–]ₙ (benzene rings joined at opposite, 1,4-positions)
i) Name the characteristic linkage and type of polymerisation in its structure
ii) Identify the two functional groups that react to form it.
iii) Name the monomers from which it is formed.
Kevlar ke diye gaye hisse se linkage, polymerisation ki qisam, functional groups aur monomers batayein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Amide linkage –CO–NH–; condensation polymerisation (Kevlar aromatic polyamide hai).
ii) Amino group –NH₂ aur carboxylic acid group –COOH (ya acyl chloride group –COCl).
iii) Benzene-1,4-diamine H₂N–C₆H₄–NH₂ aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid HOOC–C₆H₄–COOH (ya benzene-1,4-dicarbonyl chloride ClOC–C₆H₄–COCl) (26.3).

blocks.prompt:
b) Explain why the reaction between an acyl chloride and ammonia is classified as a condensation reaction. Identify the small molecule that is eliminated during this reaction.
Acyl chloride aur ammonia ka reaction condensation kyun kehlata hai? Kaun sa chhota molecule nikalta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Do molecules jur kar bara molecule (amide) banate hain aur saath hi aik chhota molecule nikal jata hai; isi ko condensation reaction kehte hain (26.1.2).
CH₃COCl + NH₃ → CH₃CONH₂ + HCl
Nikalne wala chhota molecule hydrogen chloride, HCl, hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) For the following monomers:
ethanedioyl chloride (ClOC–COCl) and ethane-1,2-diol (HO–CH₂–CH₂–OH)
I) Predict the type of the polymer formed.
ii) Draw the repeat unit and a section of the expected polymer.
iii) Name this polymer systematically.
In monomers se kis qisam ka polymer banega, repeat unit aur hissa banayein, aur systematic naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
I) Condensation polymer: polyester (–COCl aur –OH ester links banate hain aur HCl nikalta hai) (26.4.2).
ii) Repeat unit: [–O–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–CO–]ₙ
Hissa: …–O–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–CO–O–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–CO–…
n ClOC–COCl + n HOCH₂CH₂OH → [–O–CH₂CH₂–O–CO–CO–]ₙ + 2n HCl
iii) Poly(ethane-1,2-diyl ethanedioate), PET ke naam poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate) ki tarah.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Monomers se polymer pehchanne ka tareeqa: C=C ho to addition polymer; do functional groups hon to condensation polymer. –OH + –COOH/–COCl = polyester; –NH₂ + –COOH/–COCl = polyamide. –COOH ho to paani, –COCl ho to HCl nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) For Nylon 6,6 (from 1,6-hexanediamine and 1,4-hexandioic acid acid):
i) Name the linkage.
ii) Name the small molecule eliminated.
iii) Draw the repeating unit.
Nylon 6,6 ki linkage, nikalne wala molecule aur repeating unit batayein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Amide linkage, –CO–NH–.
ii) Paani, H₂O.
iii) [–NH–(CH₂)₆–NH–CO–(CH₂)₄–CO–]ₙ
n H₂N(CH₂)₆NH₂ + n HOOC(CH₂)₄COOH → [–NH(CH₂)₆NH–CO(CH₂)₄CO–]ₙ + 2n H₂O

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein '1,4-hexandioic acid acid' chhapa hai. Adipic acid, HOOC–(CH₂)₄–COOH, ke COOH carbons C1 aur C6 par hain, is liye sahi naam hexanedioic acid (hexane-1,6-dioic acid) hai; 'acid' ka lafz bhi do baar chhapa hai.

blocks.prompt:
e) For poly(chloroethene) (PVC)
i) Name the monomer for PVC
ii) Why can it undergo addition polymerization?
PVC ka monomer kya hai aur yeh addition polymerisation kyun kar sakta hai?
blocks.explanation:
i) Chloroethene (vinyl chloride), CH₂=CHCl.
ii) Is mein C=C double bond hai jo khul jata hai aur monomers aik doosre se sire se sira jur jate hain, kuch nahi nikalta: n CH₂=CHCl → [–CH₂–CHCl–]ₙ (26.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
f) State two properties of nylon that make it suitable for ropes and fishing nets.
Nylon ki do khususiyat batayein jo use rassiyon aur machhli ke jaal ke liye munasib banati hain.
blocks.explanation:
1. Zyada tensile strength (khinchav bardasht karne ki taqat): mazboot, toot-phoot, ragar aur ghisaav se bachta hai.
2. Lachakdaar (elastic) aur paani se kharab nahi hota (26.2.1, 26.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
g) Give two industrial applications for PVC and two for Nylon.
PVC aur nylon ke do do sanati istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
PVC: (1) paani ki supply, drainage aur sewage ke pipes aur fittings; (2) wires aur cables ki electrical insulation (26.1.1).
Nylon: (1) gaariyon ke parts jaise gears, bearings aur fuel lines; (2) machine parts jaise screws, nuts aur bolts (26.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
h) Draw the repeating unit of the polyester from propan-1,3-diol and benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid.
Propan-1,3-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se banne wale polyester ka repeating unit banayein.
blocks.explanation:
HO–CH₂CH₂CH₂–OH aur HOOC–C₆H₄–COOH ester links se jurte hain aur paani nikalta hai:
Repeating unit: [–O–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–C₆H₄–CO–]ₙ (C₆H₄ ring 1,4 positions par juri hui)

blocks.prompt:
i) State three distinct environmental problems caused by the disposal of non-degradable polymers.
Ghair tahleel pazeer (non-degradable) polymers ko phenkne se paida hone wale teen mukhtalif mahauliyati masail likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh bohat lamba arsa qaim rehte hain, landfills, samandaron aur zameen par jama hote hain aur landfills ki bohat jagah gherte hain.
2. Janwar, khaas tor par samandari, plastic ko khana samajh lete hain ya us mein ulajh jate hain; dam ghutna, zakhm ya bhook se maut.
3. Yeh toot kar microplastics bante hain jo mitti, paani aur hawa ko aaluda karte hain aur food chain mein dakhil hote hain (26.5).

blocks.prompt:
j) Name two different polymers used in artificial organs and state the specific application for each.
Masnoi aaza (artificial organs) mein istemal hone wale do polymers aur un ka khaas istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Poly(tetrafluoroethylene) (PTFE): masnoi khoon ki naliyan (grafts); is ki chikni satah khoon ko jamne se rokti hai.
2. Ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE): masnoi kulhe aur ghutne ke jor; chikna, kam ragar (low friction) aur ghisaav se bachne wala (Table 26.2).

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar banaye jane wale jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) Describe the chemical role of plasticizers in polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and explain how this modification influences the polymer's industrial applications.
PVC mein plasticizers ka chemical kirdar bayan karein aur batayein ke is tabdeeli se is ke sanati istemal par kya asar parta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Kirdar: plasticizers woh chemicals hain jo PVC mein milaye jate hain; yeh polymer chains ke darmiyan ghus kar un ke beech ki mazboot forces kam karte hain. Chains aik doosre par phisal sakti hain, is liye PVC naram, lachakdaar aur aasaani se shakal badalne wala ho jata hai (26.1.1).
Istemal par asar:
• Rigid PVC (baghair plasticizer): sakht, akra hua, chemically inert (react na karne wala), achha insulator, aag se bachne wala, mausam se kharab na hone wala; pipes aur fittings, khirkiyon ke frames aur darwazon ke profiles.
• Plasticised PVC: lachakdaar aur naram, chemical aur electrical khususiyat achhi rehti hain lekin sakhti kam; wires aur cables ki insulation, tubing, blood bags aur catheters, cling films, barsatiyan, masnoi chamra, hawa bharne wali cheezen aur farsh ki sheets.
Yun plasticizer ki miqdar badal kar aik hi polymer sakht aur lachakdaar dono qisam ki cheezon ke liye istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
b) Explain why poly(alkenes) like poly(ethene) pose a greater environmental challenge than polyesters and polyamides. Identify the chemical process that allows the latter to degrade.
Poly(ethene) jaise poly(alkenes) polyesters aur polyamides se zyada mahauliyati masla kyun hain? Baad wale kis chemical amal se toot-te hain?
blocks.explanation:
Poly(ethene) jaise poly(alkenes) ka backbone sirf mazboot, non-polar C–C aur C–H bonds ka hai aur koi functional group nahi. Paani, acids, alkalis aur mitti ke jaraseem in par hamla nahi kar sakte, is liye yeh non-biodegradable hain; yeh bohat lamba arsa rehte hain, landfills bharte hain, janwaron ko nuqsan dete hain aur microplastics bante hain (26.5).
Polyesters aur polyamides mein polar ester (–COO–) aur amide (–CONH–) links hain. Mitti ke jandaar in links ko tor sakte hain, is liye yeh saada compounds mein toot jate hain:
polyester → carboxylic acids + alcohols; polyamide → carboxylic acids + amines (26.5.1).
In ki tooti phooti ka chemical amal ester aur amide links ki hydrolysis (paani se torna) hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 Compare and contrast addition and condensation polymerization, giving details of the specific structural requirements for the monomers in each.
Addition aur condensation polymerisation ka muwazna karein aur har aik mein monomers ki structural sharait batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Mushabihat: dono bohat saare monomers ko jor kar lambi chain wale polymers banate hain (26.1). Farq aur har aik mein monomers ki structural shart table mein hain.
Addition: n CH₂=CH₂ → (initiator, heat/pressure) [–CH₂–CH₂–]ₙ
Condensation: n H₂N–R–NH₂ + n HOOC–R'–COOH → [–HN–R–NH–CO–R'–CO–]ₙ + 2n H₂O

rows: Monomer mein C=C (ya C≡C) bond zaroori
Monomer(s) mein kam az kam do reactive functional groups (–OH, –COOH, –NH₂, –COCl) zaroori
Double bond khulta hai; monomers aik aik kar ke jurte hain
Mukhtalif monomers ke functional groups aapas mein react karte hain
Koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta; saare atoms polymer mein
Har link par chhota molecule (H₂O, HCl, CH₃OH ya NH₃) nikalta hai
Repeat unit mein monomer jitne hi atoms
Repeat unit mein monomers se kam atoms
Backbone mein sirf carbon (–C–C–C–)
Backbone mein C ke saath O ya N (ester ya amide links)
Initiator (free radicals) se shuru hone wala chain reaction
Qadam ba qadam (step-by-step) reaction
Aam tor par aik monomer (homopolymer); kabhi copolymer
Aam tor par do mukhtalif monomers; ya aik monomer jis mein dono groups (amino acid, lactic acid)
Misal poly(ethene), PVC, poly(propene)
Misal nylon 6,6, Kevlar, PET (Terylene)

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 Illustrate the formation of two major condensation polymers.
Do ahem condensation polymers ki banawat equations se dikhayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Polyester: PET (Terylene), ethane-1,2-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se. Diol ka –OH acid ke –COOH se react karta hai, ester links –CO–O– bante hain aur paani nikalta hai (26.1.2):
n HO–CH₂–CH₂–OH + n HOOC–C₆H₄–COOH → [–O–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–C₆H₄–CO–]ₙ + 2n H₂O
Istemal: resha (fibre) (cotton ka mutabadil, silwaten nahi parteen) aur mashroobat ki plastic bottles aur khane ki packing.
2. Polyamide: nylon 6,6, hexane-1,6-diamine aur hexanedioic (adipic) acid se. Diamine ka –NH₂ acid ke –COOH se react karta hai, amide links –CO–NH– bante hain aur paani nikalta hai (26.2):
n H₂N–(CH₂)₆–NH₂ + n HOOC–(CH₂)₄–COOH → [–NH–(CH₂)₆–NH–CO–(CH₂)₄–CO–]ₙ + 2n H₂O
Istemal: kapre, qaleen, rassiyan aur machhli ke jaal, gears aur bearings.
(Acid ki jagah dioyl chloride, ClOC–R–COCl, ho to paani ki bajaye HCl nikalta hai.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: 2n H₂O kyun? Nylon 6,6 aur PET ke har repeat unit mein do links (amide ya ester) hain aur har link banne par aik H₂O nikalta hai, is liye n units ke liye taqreeban 2n H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 Differentiate between the environmental degradation of poly(alkenes) and polyesters.
Poly(alkenes) aur polyesters ki mahaul mein tooti phooti (degradation) mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Farq backbone ki wajah se hai: polyesters mein hydrolysis hone wale ester links hain, poly(alkenes) mein nahi (26.5, 26.5.1).

rows: Backbone mein sirf mazboot, non-polar C–C aur C–H bonds
Backbone mein polar ester links –COO–
Chemically inert; paani ya jaraseem ke hamle ke liye koi group nahi
Mitti ke jandaar ester links ko hydrolysis se torte hain
Non-biodegradable
Biodegradable (poly(alkenes) se zyada)
Bohat lamba arsa rehte hain; landfills bharte hain; microplastics bante hain
Saada compounds, carboxylic acids aur alcohols mein toot jate hain
Mitti, paani aur samandari zindagi ki der tak aaludgi
Kam der rehte hain; ghulne wale tankon (stitches) aur implants mein istemal

items: MCQs ke jawab: I b, II b, III c, IV b, V a, VI d, VII b, VIII c, IX c, X b.
Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ II(b) 'Hcl' (HCl), Q2(d) '1,4-hexandioic acid acid' (hexanedioic acid).
